crossRefs.note: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.
Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on…
and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because…
Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the…
They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down…
Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”
Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be…

translations.web: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
translations.bsb: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
translations.kjv: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
translations.asv: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame That say unto me, Aha, aha.
